title: Project Preserve Destiny code name Staunch 118
plain: In 1991, at a training site in Maryland run by the NSA, America's signals-spying agency, a former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says he was given the code name "Staunch 118" for a secret programme called Project Preserve Destiny. Sherman tells this from his own experience, saying the agency hired him to communicate with aliens. If true, it would mean the government ran a programme for talking with non-human beings.
